share_mib.formula: Vol.1 E2 VRAM median 31,769 MiB (benchmark/results/e2_nim_vs_ollama.json, NIM and Ollama rows both, n=300 each) − NIM alone 30,425 MiB (results/e7/c/c_cohabit.json cell A1 vram p50, n=30)

num_gpu_derivation.method_used: calibrated: largest num_gpu whose measured Ollama GPU footprint (nvidia-smi delta vs num_gpu=0, NIM not running) ≤ share

calibration.cross_check: nvidia-smi delta and llama-server dedicated counter agree within 20 MiB at every num_gpu

method_in_P02_not_used.per_layer_from_tensor_list: block weights avg 124.77 MiB (117.03/132.50) + KV f16 @16384 ctx 64.0 MiB = 188.77 MiB ⇒ floor(1344/188.77) = 7; exact cumulative last-N blocks: 6 blocks 1,163.53 MiB ≤ 1,344 < 7 blocks 1,344.56 MiB ⇒ 6
method_in_P02_not_used.why_not_used: precheck measured num_gpu=6 at 2,251 MiB (1.7× the share): the formula omits Ollama's fixed GPU compute buffer (~1.0 GB at num_gpu=1). It would not reproduce Vol.1's share, which is the question of the ticket.

assumptions: the desktop baseline during Vol.1 equals C's (C prelaunch 1,816 MiB). Consistency check: C A1 30,425 − 1,816 = 28,609 MiB ≈ the NIM container's own dedicated GPU memory measured today, 28,600.7 MiB (precheck2). Vol.1's desktop baseline was not recorded.
NIM-alone footprint today (30,425) equals Vol.1's; Vol.1 E1 recorded 31,070 MiB under driver 577.00 — with that value the share is 699 MiB and no num_gpu ≥ 1 fits (num_gpu=0)
Ollama's footprint with NIM present equals the footprint measured without NIM
Vol.1's Ollama version and context length were not recorded; its compute buffer and KV size may differ from today's

🔴 the Vol.1 total 31,769 MiB is 97.4% of the reported 32,607 MiB: a near-saturated total has little discriminating power, so the share derived from it is itself weak. If Vol.1 had system-memory fallback, Ollama's true GPU share then is unknown.

prediction_2.claim: B′ NIM TTFT avg in 180–270 ms (Vol.1 221)

p02_matrix.1✅ 2✅: Vol.1 condition reproduced; 221 ms is the co-residence cost in that shape
p02_matrix.1✅ 2❌: shape right, magnitude not ⇒ a third factor (version? driver?); report as is, no guessing
p02_matrix.1❌ 2❌: the VRAM ledger cannot reproduce Vol.1's shape; record and stop

verdict_rules.a1_gate: A1 NIM TTFT avg in [30, 80] ms, else stop before loading Ollama
verdict_rules.nim_process_identification: largest dedicated growth idle→ready snapshot, ≥ 20000 MiB; otherwise the mechanism is unestablished
verdict_rules.ollama_process_identification: largest dedicated growth among processes named llama-server between A1 end and after warm-up
verdict_rules.squeezed_definition: NIM process dedicated median in B′ lower than in A1 by more than 1000 MiB, OR its shared median higher by more than 1000 MiB (sampler rows within each cell; cell start/end snapshots if no rows)
verdict_rules.elevated_definition: B′ NIM TTFT avg ≥ 2 × max(A1, A2)
verdict_rules.concurrent_definition: in B′, sampler rows whose collection interval lies entirely inside a NIM request window; a row counts as Ollama-active if the Ollama process GPU engine utilization sum > 5%
verdict_rules.noise_definition: span (max−min) of the NIM process dedicated memory across A1 sampler rows; above 500 MiB the mechanism verdict is unestablished

p09_matrix.compute_contention: compute contention (footprint not squeezed, TTFT elevated)
p09_matrix.memory_pressure: memory pressure (footprint squeezed, TTFT elevated, no Ollama GPU activity inside NIM requests)
p09_matrix.inseparable: inseparable (footprint squeezed AND Ollama GPU activity inside NIM requests)
p09_matrix.inseparable_insufficient_concurrency_evi: inseparable (squeezed and elevated, fewer than 3 sampler rows inside NIM requests)
p09_matrix.neither: neither (not squeezed, not elevated) — look elsewhere
p09_matrix.squeezed_but_ttft_not_elevated: footprint squeezed but TTFT not elevated

verdict_rules.unestablished_sentence: 機制未確立（mechanism not established）. ⛔ Do not write that co-residence causes the TTFT rise.

p09_required_sentence: 若三格的 NIM 足跡與 TTFT 走向無法分辨「算力競爭」與「記憶體壓力」，結論寫「機制未確立」。⛔ 不寫「同住造成 TTFT 上升」。
p09_note_on_design: cells alternate NIM and Ollama requests, so the two engines are not generating at the same time by design; 'compute contention' here can only be residual (scheduling / context switching), which is why Ollama GPU activity inside NIM request windows is measured instead of assumed.
